Technical data
Both engines receive the same QUBO. Three runs per engine, concurrent isolated processes. The displayed time is the sum of solver calls; warm-up, Meta API and network latency are excluded. Full request time is shown separately.
Dense benchmarks: CPU 8 reads × 200 sweeps; GPU 128 agents × 1,000 steps. These are different algorithms and budgets, not equal-work experiments.
Examples are synthetic. User JSON is validated before execution. Downloaded results include seeds, versions, device evidence and the problem hash. Large examples have no proven optimum.
